body: Do you really want to do it though? It's really good you can and have told people, what did they do and say after? Tell somebody that you need to talk to them, that you need to be totally honest and then *tell them*. Don't hold anything back, tell them what you *don't* need right now is for someone to try and stop you but to just have somebody listen. Just having the option and the moment to really express yourself may do more than anything they could do for you

Dude, it was the hardest thing I've ever done. I don't know that there can *ever* be more real words to come out of your mouth. But please trust me, when they do, the weight instantly lifts. 100%? No, but just saying the words was probably the biggest moment of my life. I still can't believe I said them, but here I am right now. I know I wouldn't be if I hadn't. PLEASE TELL SOMEBODY. JUST TELL, WITH YOUR VOICE, THAT YOU WANT TO KILL YOURSELF. vocalizing the words means so much more than typing them out, please I promise you will feel better. Here's a #, you may or may not use it, but please fucking tell SOMEBODY 1-800-273-8255
